members.name: afternoon_profit_fade
members.thesis: Exploits intraday profit booking. Intraday traders in India typically flatten positions between 14:30 and 15:15 to avoid margin penalties or overnight risk. This creates a predictable mean-reversion counter-move to the day's primary trend. Arbitrage is limited by the short time window before the clo
weaknesses: Short squeeze can accelerate instead of fading
Liquidity drops sharply in the last 15 mins

members.name: european_open_momentum_continuation
members.thesis: Exploits the liquidity influx from the London/European market open (13:30 IST). Arbitrageurs and global macro funds trade ADR/GDR underlyings at this time, creating a directional 'push' in liquid Indian large-caps that persists until the US pre-market opens.
weaknesses: European macro events can trigger reversals
Reliance on global flows which can be absent on European holidays
